node.name: Write verification results
node.description: Saves this run's verification results, which next week's run reads to skip unchanged companies.

inputParameters.name: method
inputParameters.description:
Enter the HTTP method of your call:  
• GET – Get data  
• POST – Send data  
• PATCH – Update data with only the fields you specify  
• PUT – Update data entirely  
• DELETE – Remove data  
• HEAD – To check if the endpoint is reachable  
• OPTIONS – Get the supported HTTP methods  
• QUERY – Query data using a request body

inputParameters.name: url
inputParameters.description: Enter the endpoint to send the requests to, e.g. https://httpbin.org/post

inputParameters.name: queryString
inputParameters.description: Enter any query parameters to set when making the API Request i.e. email -> eric@clay.com

inputParameters.name: body
inputParameters.description:
Enter the data body to include, e.g:  
```json
{
	"email": "sam@clay.com",
	"age": 1,
	"is_active": true
}
```
It follows the rules of JSON bodies, so booleans/numbers will not be surrounded by quotes, but strings will.

inputParameters.name: headers
inputParameters.description:
Enter request headers as JSON, e.g:  
`{"Content-Type": "application/json"}`  
💡 **Tip:** Store credentials like `X-API-Key` or `Authorization` in an HTTP API (Headers) account for added security and so you can reuse them.

inputParameters.name: fieldPaths
inputParameters.description: Want to keep just specific parts of the API response? Enter the fields you need here—for example: email, name, or contact.email.status. Use dots to access nested data. Leave this blank to keep everything.

inputParameters.name: removeNull
inputParameters.description: Toggle this field if you want to remove any values that are empty, null, or undefined from the request. This is useful when you want to avoid sending empty values to an API so no data is overwritten for blank fields.

inputParameters.name: returnResponseMetadata
inputParameters.description: Toggle this field if you want to return additional information from the API call, including the status code and headers.

inputParameters.name: followRedirects
inputParameters.description: Toggle this field if you want to follow HTTP 3xx responses (e.g. 301, 302, 303, 307, 308). This is useful if you want to follow redirects to the final URL. Defaults to true.

inputParameters.name: responseTimeout
inputParameters.description: Override the default maximum wait time for a response from the API in milliseconds. Minimum is 1000ms and maximum is 100000ms.

inputParameters.name: shouldRetry
inputParameters.description: Toggle this field if you want to retry the request if it fails. Defaults to true.
